The '''KV807-A engine system''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] engine produced by [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Built primarily for [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] combat, the system's rotational thrusters allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to stop all forward momentum and spin to face a specific target.
